SUPERVISOR — USER VERDICT on the workbench hero/header bar (gutter 3 top). Marker: HEROBAR-0606, resolve the req the hook captures (or req_0028 if relayed).

USER, verbatim: "this header is crowded, and there is a button in that array u cant even see, also, notice how the buttons are tight for space in their own container here. have this whole thing cleaned up / different shape but same data. because this is just poor thinking. put the buttons as a row on the bottom or top of this, and then do a row with the icon and name and then under than another row with columns of the meta data details."

Their SCREENSHOT (read it): /home/siah/.claude/image-cache/c73c0a8c-84f9-4fad-b702-d4288adbf7bb/15.png — shows the crowding: icon + "character 16uawcw" squeezed beside Save/Generate chips, at least one action clipped invisible, meta lines (character · 9 groups · 65 fields) cramped under.

The PRESCRIBED layout (build exactly this, same data, shell-level so every source inherits):
Row 1: icon + name (full width, room to breathe).
Row 2: the metadata details as COLUMNS (kind · groups · fields ...).
Row 3 (top or bottom — pick what reads best with the gutter, state your pick): ALL the action buttons in their own full-width row — every action visible, never clipped.
This lives in the shell (Workbench.tsx hero area / workbench.cls classes) — one fix, every category inherits. No data changes, no new actions. Small commit, explicit paths, verify green. READY when the user sees every button and nothing crowded.
resolution: HEROBAR-0606: the gutter-3 hero restructured to the user's prescribed stack at the SHELL level (every source inherits, same data, no new actions): row 1 icon+name full-width; row 2 metadata as columns (value over tiny label — SOURCE/GROUPS/FIELDS); row 3 all action buttons in a full-width WRAPPING row at the bottom (pick stated: identity → facts → verbs, verbs adjacent to the panel they act on; flexWrap guarantees no button is ever clipped). New Hero* classes in workbench.cls; studio's HeroBar kit untouched for the map editor's panel. Bundle green; suites unaffected (display-only). Visual confirmation pending-selfshot.
